title: Landmark map of human brain’s gene activity holds clues to Alzheimer’s disease and more
title_zh: 人类大脑基因活性里程碑地图揭示阿尔茨海默病及其他疾病线索
abstract: The atlas of gene expression in the prefrontal cortex was created using samples from almost 1,500 donors of all ages — from infants to centenarians.
abstract_zh: 该前额叶皮层基因表达图谱基于近1500名不同年龄段捐献者的样本创建，涵盖从婴儿到百岁老人。
